basics.name: Sameer Vishwakarma
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer building full-stack web apps, AI-integrated tools, and IoT systems. Currently building production IoT and data-visualization projects at RAIoT Labs while leading student teams through hackathons and technical competitions.

work.name: RAIoT Labs
work.summary: Building and deploying IoT hardware/software projects, bridging sensor hardware with full-stack dashboards for real-time data visualization.
highlights: Build and deploy IoT hardware/software projects bridging sensors with full-stack real-time dashboards
Lead student teams in hackathons, robowars, and autonomous flight competitions

projects.name: Trackly AI — Productivity Platform
projects.description: Full-stack productivity app with a Chrome extension that blocks distracting sites when deadlines are missed; integrates Gemini 2.5 Flash vision + language for real-time habit verification.

projects.name: Align — AI Resume Analyzer
projects.description: Matches candidate resumes to live job postings via PyPDF2 parsing + NLP skill extraction, served through a Next.js frontend and Flask API.

projects.name: AI Sign Language Translator
projects.description: Multi-layer LSTM model translating continuous sign language into text for medical/emergency phrases, processing 1,692 spatial landmarks per 30-frame sequence via MediaPipe.

projects.name: EduRep — Education Transparency Tracker
projects.description: Transparency platform tracking education budgets, court mandates, and RTI responses on a custom Prisma/SQLite schema.
